title: Lagos Online
description: The open world, shared with other players: Iyana-Wahala, Nkwo Agu, Royal Crest, Lekki, Computer Village, Abuja and Port Harcourt, joined by buses and flights. Not part of any story.

beats.objective: Iyana-Wahala. Meet people, play, bet. The motor park has buses to Nkwo Agu and the campus.
Nkwo Agu. Ayò under the palm-wine shade, palms to climb. Buses back at the junction.
Royal Crest University. Akara, penalties, the back gate. Buses at the main gate.
Lekki: the expressway, Pearl Estate behind its wall, the beach. Buses at the stop by the tech hub.
Computer Village, Ikeja: phones, fixers, the warehouses and the customs yard. Buses at the stop.
Maitama and Wuse, Abuja: the secretariat, the banks, the EFCC office, the big houses. The airport shuttle is by the secretariat.
The Port Harcourt waterfront: the jetty, the boathouse yard, the bars. The airport shuttle is at the west end.
